narr: A combination of high values of precipitable water and weak mid level flow produced favorable conditions for slow moving thunderstorms with high rainfall rates, resulting in separate flash flood events within the city limits of Tuscaloosa.
ev: A cluster of slow moving thunderstorms containing heavy rain produced totals of 1 to 2 inches in a short period of time in the city of Tuscaloosa, resulting in flash flooding. Several roads flooded and impassable, including portions of McFarland Blvd and University Blvd, along with several stalled out vehicles.

A nearly stationary thunderstorm developed over the city of Tuscaloosa and produced rainfall totals of 1 to 2 inches in a short period of time. Several locations along McFarland Blvd were under water and impassable.
